description:
One gol24.uz news item together with all related items of the same story (every step of a transfer saga, reactions to one match), related items newest first. Use it after latest_news, club_news, person_news or search_news returned an item and the user wants the background or follow-ups.
Accepts the item's id, its slug, or the full https://gol24.uz/yangilik/... URL.
Returns the item and up to 20 related items with the same fields as latest_news; "related" is empty when the item has no story yet. Returns an error if the item does not exist or is not published. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute.

news.description: The "id" (e.g. "19176") or "url" of an item returned by another gol24 tool; a slug also works.
